The private Lexkite admin console (Vietnamese labels) used by the small team running Lexkite, a free English-learning app. Feel: calm, confident and premium, data-dense yet airy, as polished as the very best modern SaaS dashboards; built on the Lexkite Kit design system: deep teal brand, one warm coral primary action per view, soft cream light theme ("Bright Day"), rounded tactile cards with a gentle ledge, friendly but grown-up.
